answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Each submission hangs on the orchard of a task receipt, and the harbor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the ocean of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
